limitations: N=1 independent Chromium per condition; six cycles are not independent repetitions.
Changed cohort: 640x360/2400k, three chunks and H.264 level 3.0; historical quantitative values are not directly comparable.
Control/R6.1/R6.2 use identical files; tail-moov files use separate encoding with the same settings and differ slightly in size.
R6.1 attributes only the composite Range/Blob/scheduler/processLock boundary.
Known logical ownership is measured separately from native memory; private commit is not VRAM and working sets may share pages.
The R5-R2 runner frozen bytes remain unavailable; the cached bytecode comparison does not recover their hash.
No leak, security defect or universal memory bound is established. Real VideoStreamService integration remains untested.
